label: Best in Class
corporate_parent: KD Navien Co., Ltd. — subsidiary of Kyungdong Group, Seoul, South Korea
manufacturing_location: Seoul, South Korea (Kyungdong Navien manufacturing complex)

heat_exchanger.description: Dual stainless steel heat exchangers. All-stainless design avoids copper's susceptibility to acidic condensate corrosion. Navien was an early adopter of dual stainless in the residential market.

burner_system.description: Premix burner system with 13,300–199,900 BTU modulation range. Low NOx (20 ppm).

recirculation_system.name: ComfortFlow
recirculation_system.description: Built-in recirculation pump with integrated buffer tank eliminates 'cold water sandwich' effect. Hot water available faster without wasting water waiting for temperature to stabilize.

construction.body: Wall-mounted, ~17" W x 13" D, similar compact form factor to competitors
construction.venting: 2" PVC up to 75 ft, 3" PVC up to 150 ft — longest vent runs in category

performance_evidence.temperature_rise: Excellent — 11.2 GPM max makes this the highest flow in calibration set
performance_evidence.recirculation: ComfortFlow BUILT-IN — buffer tank + pump. No external pump needed. Eliminates cold water sandwich. Timer and temperature-based activation.
performance_evidence.smart_connectivity: NaviLink WiFi module for remote monitoring, diagnostics, error code alerts, and scheduling.
performance_evidence.cascading: Up to 12 units can be cascaded with common venting — commercial-grade scalability
performance_evidence.gas_pipe: Compatible with 1/2" gas pipe up to 24' — reduces installation cost for retrofit

heat_exchanger_warranty.conditions: CRITICAL: 15yr HX warranty ONLY with controlled recirculation (aquastat/timer). Drops to 5yr with uncontrolled (continuous) recirculation. This is a material warranty restriction.

parts_availability.description: Navien has built strong US parts distribution as market share has grown. Parts available through wholesale and online channels.

service_network.description: Navien certified installer program. Growing network as US market share expands.

common_failure_modes.primary: Scale buildup on heat exchanger (same as all tankless — annual flushing required)
common_failure_modes.secondary: Control board/PCB issues (more complex electronics than simpler competitors)
common_failure_modes.tertiary: Recirculation pump failure (additional moving part vs competitors without built-in pump)

safety_evidence.certifications: ANSI Z21.10.3 / CSA 4.3 certified. Low NOx (20 ppm).
safety_evidence.venting: Power direct vent. PVC venting (condensing). Field-convertible gas.

platform_disclosure.corporate: KD Navien is a subsidiary of Kyungdong Group. Kyungdong also manufactures boilers, HVAC equipment. Navien brand is dedicated to tankless/combi water heaters in the US market.
platform_disclosure.cross_brand: None identified — Navien does not rebadge for other brands in US.

S: VACANT — No Yale Appliance equivalent for water heaters
